title: Keep implementation agents from self-approving repository PRs

intent.outcome: Satisfy the issue-owner clarification for #2725 entirely in this repository: implementation agents report fixes applied / ready for re-review, never run the independent-review procedure or approve their own PRs, and the repo-owned gate admits only its separately configured review automation.
non_goals: Do not add portable AW verifier classes, review routing, proof admission, schemas, or runtime projections.
Do not control or interfere with external consumers' repository review procedures.
Do not add signing keys, per-attempt attestations, or consumer-facing review infrastructure.
Do not grant this implementation session independent review or merge authority.

parent.contribution: Makes the verifier boundary trustworthy before the cross-owner enforcement and delegation lanes consume it.
parent.closure_boundary: This slice may close only #2725; #2562, #2721, and the all-open-issues decomposition remain live.

effects: Repo-owned maintainer guidance reserves authoritative review markers for the separately configured review automation.
The repository exact-head gate admits marker decisions only from that configured dispatcher app; GitHub login and association remain transport metadata.
Implementation agents retain a non-authoritative fixes-applied / ready-for-re-review path and never approve their own PRs.

refs: Repo-owned review-loop and merge-gate proof passed
Portable AW review-procedure delta removed per issue-owner clarification

delegation.reason: No sub-agent delegation was requested; independent review authority must remain outside this implementation session.

next_action: Publish the repaired #2776 head, restack #2777-#2779, then obtain current-head independent review before ordered integration.

claims: Implementation agents do not use this repository's independent-review skill or emit authoritative review markers.
An ordinary owner-login implementation comment is non-authoritative, while the separately configured connector review automation is accepted.
No portable AW contract or external-consumer review procedure is changed.
proof.summary: Repo-owned proof is green: 112 review-loop/stack/merge-gate tests, Ruff, and maintainer surfaces passed. Portable AW review-procedure changes and the package changeset were removed per the issue-owner clarification; publication/restack and independent review remain pending.
requirements: Run operating-decision, startup, implement, proof-admission, PR-intake, review-loop, and merge-gate fixtures.
Run routed changed-path proof, lint, typecheck, generated parity, and workspace-wide validation.

continuation.residual_intent: After this lane, implement #2762, then #2763, then reconcile parent closure.

execution_bounds.ask_before: Adding a new review command, changing repository merge authority, merging a PR, or weakening configured verifier modes.
execution_bounds.stop_conditions: Stop if the repository-only rule would require portable AW review machinery, cryptographic attestation, or consumer-facing workflow changes.
